query: Who played Rocket in the movie called 'Guardians of the Galaxy'?
sql_query:
select distinct p.name 
from people p 
join crew c on p.person_id = c.person_id
join titles t on c.title_id = t.title_id 
where t.original_title  = 'Guardians of the Galaxy'
and t."type" = 'movie'
and c."characters" like '%Rocket%'
